words.enDefinition: a public body responsible for issuing or overseeing licences of a stated kind

examples.en: I asked which licensing authority had issued the permit shown in the leaflet.
examples.zh: 我问宣传单上的许可是哪个「许可签发机关」发的。

examples.en: The form gave the address of the licensing authority at the bottom.
examples.zh: 表格底部写了「许可签发机关」的地址。

words.enDefinition: an office that handles applications, renewals or records for drivers' licences

examples.en: I went to the driver licensing office after copying the appointment details.
examples.zh: 抄好预约信息后，我去了「驾驶证业务办理处」。

examples.en: The driver licensing office posted a separate schedule for document collection that week.
examples.zh: 「驾驶证业务办理处」单独公布了那周领证的时间安排。

collocations: an appointment at the driver licensing office

words.zhGloss: 美国州机动车管理部门
words.enDefinition: the name used in some US states for an agency handling drivers and vehicles
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国州机动车管理部门

examples.en: The California letter showed Department of Motor Vehicles at the top of the page.
examples.zh: 加州那封信的页首写着「美国州机动车管理部门」。

examples.en: I checked whether the Department of Motor Vehicles had updated my mailing address.
examples.zh: 我查了「美国州机动车管理部门」有没有更新我的邮寄地址。

collocations: contact the Department of Motor Vehicles
visit the Department of Motor Vehicles
a Department of Motor Vehicles notice

words.enDefinition: a request to a public authority for a licence to drive specified vehicles

examples.en: I saved a copy of my driving licence application before taking it to the office.
examples.zh: 去办事处之前，我留存了一份「驾驶执照申请」副本。

examples.en: The clerk marked a missing answer on the driving licence application I brought.
examples.zh: 办事员标出了我带来的「驾驶执照申请」里有一项没填。

words.enDefinition: a new driving licence issued in place of one that is lost, damaged or otherwise needs replacing

examples.en: The email confirmed that my replacement licence had been sent to the correct address.
examples.zh: 邮件确认，我「补发的驾驶执照」已经寄往正确的地址。

examples.en: I asked whether I could collect the replacement licence at the local office.
examples.zh: 我问能不能去本地办事处领「补发的驾驶执照」。

words.enDefinition: an entry on a UK driving record recording a motoring offence

examples.en: The licence endorsement on my UK driving record shows the date of the offence.
examples.zh: 我的「英国驾照违章记录」上写着违规日期。

examples.en: The adviser explained how the licence endorsement appeared on the official UK driving record.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了「英国驾照违章记录」在英国官方驾驶记录上是怎样显示的。

words.enDefinition: a requirement listed on a driving licence that applies to use of the permissions it gives

examples.en: The card showed a licence condition requiring corrective lenses during driving.
examples.zh: 驾照标了一项「驾驶执照附带条件」，注明驾驶时须佩戴视力矫正镜片。

examples.en: I asked the office what the licence condition printed beside the code meant.
examples.zh: 我问办事处，代码旁印的「驾驶执照附带条件」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: a temporary loss of the permission to drive under a licence

examples.en: The notice explained when the licence suspension would begin in the sample case.
examples.zh: 通知说明了例子中的「暂停驾照效力」从何时开始。

examples.en: I read the letter about the licence suspension before contacting the licensing office.
examples.zh: 联系驾驶证业务办理处前，我读了关于「暂停驾照效力」的信。

words.enDefinition: officially restoring driving privileges after a licence has been suspended or otherwise made inactive

examples.en: The office sent a letter showing the effective date of the licence reinstatement.
examples.zh: 办事处发了封信，写明「恢复驾照效力」的生效日期。

examples.en: The caseworker explained which entry referred to licence reinstatement on the sample record.
examples.zh: 承办人员解释了样本记录中哪一条指「恢复驾照效力」。

words.enDefinition: an official decision preventing someone from holding or using driving privileges for a period

examples.en: The driving disqualification was listed separately from the penalty points on the record.
examples.zh: 记录把「禁止驾驶」与交通违规记分分开列出。

examples.en: The adviser explained what driving disqualification meant on the notice shown in class.
examples.zh: 顾问讲解了课堂上出示的通知里「禁止驾驶」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: the official permission to drive a vehicle or category of vehicles

examples.en: The record showed my driving entitlement for the category listed on the left.
examples.zh: 记录显示了左侧车型类别对应的「获准驾驶的权限」。

examples.en: I asked whether the new document would show the same driving entitlement as before.
examples.zh: 我问新文件是否会显示与原来相同的「获准驾驶的权限」。

words.enDefinition: a Canadian official summary of a person's driving record

examples.en: I requested a driver's abstract before applying to drive the university's shuttle van.
examples.zh: 我先申请了一份「驾驶记录摘要」，再报名驾驶学校的接驳车。

examples.en: The office checked which years the driver's abstract covered before accepting it.
examples.zh: 办事处确认「驾驶记录摘要」涵盖的年份后才收下。

words.enDefinition: a letter from an authority confirming information about a driving licence

examples.en: The office asked whether my licence verification letter came from the issuing authority.
examples.zh: 办事处问，我的「驾驶证核验函」是不是签发机关开的。

examples.en: I placed the licence verification letter beside the translated copy of my original card.
examples.zh: 我把「驾驶证核验函」和原证件的翻译件放在一起。

collocations: a licence verification letter from the issuing authority

words.enDefinition: a text in another language giving information from a driving licence

examples.en: The desk asked whether the licence translation included both sides of the card.
examples.zh: 柜台问，「驾驶证翻译件」有没有涵盖证件的正反两面。

examples.en: I saved the licence translation with the rest of my documents for the appointment.
examples.zh: 我把「驾驶证翻译件」和赴约要带的其他材料放在了一起。

words.enDefinition: a driving licence in the form of a card bearing the holder's photograph

examples.en: The example showed a photocard licence with its holder's details partly covered.
examples.zh: 示例展示了一张「带照片的卡式驾照」，遮住了持证人的部分信息。

examples.en: The desk recorded the date printed on my photocard licence before returning it.
examples.zh: 柜台记录了「带照片的卡式驾照」上的日期，然后把它还给我。

words.enDefinition: an official permission to drive for a limited interim period under stated conditions

examples.en: The agency labelled the paper as a temporary driving permit under local rules.
examples.zh: 该机构按当地用语，把那份纸质文件标为「短期驾驶许可证」。

examples.en: I checked the end date on the temporary driving permit issued by the office.
examples.zh: 我核对了办事处签发的「短期驾驶许可证」的结束日期。

words.enDefinition: a statement giving health information that a driving authority asks a driver to provide

examples.en: The form listed a medical declaration for drivers under the supporting documents section.
examples.zh: 表格在证明材料一节列出了「驾驶人健康申报」。

examples.en: I asked who should sign the medical declaration for drivers in this example.
examples.zh: 我问在这个例子里，「驾驶人健康申报」该由谁签名。

collocations: complete a medical declaration for drivers
request a medical declaration for drivers
review a medical declaration for drivers

words.enDefinition: whether a person's health or functional ability is compatible with driving safely

examples.en: The handbook explains why the office may ask about fitness to drive.
examples.zh: 手册解释了办事处为什么可能会问「适合驾驶的身心状态」。

examples.en: I read the section on fitness to drive before asking about the form.
examples.zh: 咨询表格前，我读了「适合驾驶的身心状态」一节。

collocations: report a change affecting fitness to drive

words.enDefinition: an update to the address recorded on a driving licence or its official record

examples.en: I checked whether the licence address change had appeared in my online record.
examples.zh: 我查了「驾照住址变更」是否已经显示在网上记录中。

examples.en: The office issued a receipt after recording my licence address change on Friday.
examples.zh: 办事处在周五登记了我的「驾照住址变更」，之后出了一张回执。

collocations: confirmation of a licence address change

words.enDefinition: a document confirming that a person passed a driving test

examples.en: The driving examiner handed me a test pass certificate after our appointment.
examples.zh: 考试结束后，驾驶考官给了我一份「驾考合格证明」。

examples.en: I kept the test pass certificate with my driving documents while waiting for the licence.
examples.zh: 等驾照寄到期间，我把「驾考合格证明」和驾驶材料放在一起。

words.enDefinition: an identifier assigned to a driver in an official licensing system

examples.en: The UK online form asked for the driver number printed on the licence.
examples.zh: 英国在线表格要求填写驾照上印的「驾驶人识别号」。

examples.en: I asked which field on the sample card contained the driver number.
examples.zh: 我问样本卡上哪个字段放的是「驾驶人识别号」。

words.enDefinition: a code that identifies the type of motoring offence recorded on a UK driving record

examples.en: I checked which endorsement code the example showed beside the offence date.
examples.zh: 我查看了例子在违规日期旁显示的是哪个「驾照违章代码」。

examples.en: The guide explained how to read an endorsement code on this document.
examples.zh: 指南解释了怎样读懂这份文件上的「驾照违章代码」。

words.enDefinition: a code identifying a particular limit on the holder's driving permissions

examples.en: The clerk explained which restriction code applied to the automatic class on my licence.
examples.zh: 办事员解释了我的驾照上自动挡类别对应哪个「驾照限制条件代码」。

examples.en: I checked the restriction code listed next to the category on the card.
examples.zh: 我查看了卡片上车型类别旁的「驾照限制条件代码」。

words.enDefinition: the date from which a driver first held the licence or driving entitlement being asked about

examples.en: The form's date first licensed field referred to my original licence.
examples.zh: 表格的「首次取得驾照日期」字段指的是我的第一本驾照。

examples.en: I compared the date first licensed with the issue date on my current card.
examples.zh: 我把「首次取得驾照日期」与现有驾照的签发日期作了对照。

collocations: a field for date first licensed

words.enDefinition: to formally give a licence back to the authority that issued or administers it

examples.en: I asked whether the notice required me to surrender a licence after it was replaced.
examples.zh: 我问那份通知是不是要求在换发后「交回驾驶执照」。

examples.en: The example showed where to send documents if someone needed to surrender a licence.
examples.zh: 示例注明，需要「交回驾驶执照」时应该把文件寄到哪里。

collocations: be asked to surrender a licence

words.enDefinition: a charge for issuing, renewing or otherwise processing a driving licence

examples.en: The office listed the licence fee separately from the photograph charge.
examples.zh: 办事处把「驾照办理费」和拍照费用分开列出。

examples.en: I asked where the current licence fee was shown on the application page.
examples.zh: 我问申请页面在哪里显示了当前的「驾照办理费」。

words.enDefinition: an official document confirming and detailing a vehicle's registration

examples.en: The officer checked the vehicle registration certificate before scanning the copy I provided.
examples.zh: 办事员先核查了「车辆登记证明」，再扫描我提供的副本。

examples.en: I found the vehicle registration certificate in the folder with the other car documents.
examples.zh: 我在和其他汽车文件放一起的文件夹里找到了「车辆登记证明」。

words.enDefinition: an official document or electronic record identifying ownership and relevant interests in a vehicle

examples.en: The US seller showed the vehicle title before we discussed collection arrangements.
examples.zh: 在商量什么时候取车之前，美国卖家出示了「车辆所有权凭证」。

examples.en: I checked whether the vehicle title included the same identification number as the registration.
examples.zh: 我核对了「车辆所有权凭证」的识别号码是否与登记文件一致。

words.zhGloss: 补发的车辆所有权凭证
words.enDefinition: a replacement official title provided when the earlier one is unavailable
acceptedZhAnswers: 补发的车辆所有权凭证

examples.en: The agency told us where the request for a duplicate title would be recorded.
examples.zh: 该机构告诉我们，「补发的车辆所有权凭证」申请会记录在哪里。

examples.en: I found the duplicate title in an envelope from the registration authority.
examples.zh: 我在登记机关寄来的信封里找到了「补发的车辆所有权凭证」。

words.enDefinition: a vehicle title maintained electronically instead of being issued on paper

examples.en: The agency displayed the electronic title in the account linked to my vehicle.
examples.zh: 该机构在与车辆关联的账号里显示了「电子车辆所有权凭证」。

examples.en: I asked whether the electronic title could be viewed by the new owner.
examples.zh: 我问新车主是否能查看「电子车辆所有权凭证」。

words.enDefinition: the process of updating a vehicle title to show a different owner

examples.en: The US form gave a separate section for information about the title transfer.
examples.zh: 那份美国表格为「车辆所有权过户」信息划了单独一节。

examples.en: I asked whether the title transfer had appeared in the agency's online account.
examples.zh: 我问机构的在线账号里是否已经显示「车辆所有权过户」。

words.enDefinition: a request to have a government authority issue or update a vehicle title

examples.en: The clerk returned the title application because one signature was missing.
examples.zh: 办事员因缺一个签名，退回了「车辆权属凭证申请」。

examples.en: I checked which page of the title application needed the vehicle's identification details.
examples.zh: 我查了「车辆权属凭证申请」哪一页需要车辆识别信息。

words.enDefinition: the official extension of the period for which a vehicle is registered

examples.en: I saved the registration renewal confirmation with the earlier vehicle documents.
examples.zh: 我把「车辆登记续期」确认和原来的车辆文件放在一起。

examples.en: The website placed registration renewal under a separate menu for existing vehicles.
examples.zh: 网站把「车辆登记续期」放在现有车辆的独立菜单下。

words.enDefinition: a message telling a keeper or owner about renewal of the vehicle's registration

examples.en: The registration renewal notice arrived in an envelope from the licensing office.
examples.zh: 「车辆登记续期通知」装在许可业务办公室寄来的信封里。

examples.en: I checked the date on my registration renewal notice after moving to campus.
examples.zh: 搬到学校后，我核对了「车辆登记续期通知」上的日期。

words.enDefinition: the date on which the current vehicle registration ceases to be valid

examples.en: I checked the registration expiration date shown in the vehicle's online record.
examples.zh: 我查看了车辆网上记录中显示的「车辆登记到期日」。

examples.en: The clerk pointed to the registration expiration date on the bottom line.
examples.zh: 办事员指给我看，最下面一行是「车辆登记到期日」。

words.enDefinition: evidence, such as a certificate or electronic record, that a vehicle is registered

examples.en: The office asked to see proof of registration for the vehicle in question.
examples.zh: 办事处要求查验相关车辆的「车辆登记凭证」。

examples.en: I saved a copy of the proof of registration in the car folder.
examples.zh: 我在车辆文件夹里保存了一份「车辆登记凭证」副本。

collocations: a document accepted as proof of registration

words.enDefinition: a limited-duration official registration record for a vehicle under a particular system

examples.en: The agency described the document as temporary registration in the confirmation email.
examples.zh: 机构在确认邮件中把该文件称为「临时车辆登记」。

examples.en: I checked when the temporary registration shown on the paper would end.
examples.zh: 我查看了纸上显示的「临时车辆登记」什么时候结束。

words.enDefinition: a sticker indicating a vehicle's registration or its validity period in some systems

examples.en: The US clerk placed the registration sticker next to the other documents.
examples.zh: 美国的办事员把「车辆登记贴纸」放在其他文件旁。

examples.en: I checked the registration sticker on the plate when reading the example.
examples.zh: 看示例时，我查看了车牌上的「车辆登记贴纸」。

words.enDefinition: a card or small document containing a vehicle's current registration details

examples.en: The dealer handed me a registration card with the other papers for the car.
examples.zh: 经销商把「车辆登记卡」和汽车的其他文件一起交给了我。

examples.en: I compared the registration card with the scanned copy on my phone.
examples.zh: 我把「车辆登记卡」与手机上的扫描件作了对照。

words.enDefinition: a code assigned to identify a specific vehicle

examples.en: The form requested the vehicle identification number in a separate field from the plate.
examples.zh: 表格单设了「车辆识别代码」字段，和车牌号分开。

examples.en: I checked the vehicle identification number against the code on the registration document.
examples.zh: 我用登记文件上的代码核对了「车辆识别代码」。

words.enDefinition: an inspection that checks a vehicle's VIN against its documents or records

examples.en: The office scheduled a VIN inspection before completing the registration review.
examples.zh: 办事处先安排了「车辆识别代码查验」，之后才完成登记审核。

examples.en: I asked which vehicle documents were mentioned in the VIN inspection notice.
examples.zh: 我问「车辆识别代码查验」通知提到了哪些车辆文件。

words.enDefinition: an identifier recorded for a vehicle's chassis, sometimes used to identify the entire vehicle

examples.en: The older registration form asked for a chassis number instead of the newer identifier.
examples.zh: 旧版登记表要求填「底盘编号」，没有要求填较新的识别代码。

examples.en: I checked the chassis number written on the vehicle's inspection report.
examples.zh: 我核对了车辆查验报告上写的「底盘编号」。

words.enDefinition: a code identifying a particular engine, recorded independently of a vehicle's plate

examples.en: The service report listed the engine number beside the vehicle identification number.
examples.zh: 维修报告把「发动机编号」列在车辆识别代码旁。

examples.en: I asked which field in the document was meant for the engine number.
examples.zh: 我问文件中哪个字段用来填写「发动机编号」。

words.enDefinition: the manufacturer's name and the particular model of a vehicle

examples.en: The form asked for the make and model before asking for the plate number.
examples.zh: 表格先要求填写「厂牌和车型」，再问车牌号。

examples.en: I checked the make and model against the details on the registration document.
examples.zh: 我用登记文件的详细信息核对了「厂牌和车型」。

collocations: give a vehicle's make and model

words.enDefinition: a manufacturer's designated year for a vehicle model or version

examples.en: The agency recorded the model year in a separate box from the purchase date.
examples.zh: 机构把「车型年份」放在与购买日期不同的方框里。

examples.en: I checked which model year appeared in the example on the agency's website.
examples.zh: 我查看了机构网站上的示例显示的是哪个「车型年份」。

words.enDefinition: in the UK, the person recorded as keeping and being responsible for a vehicle

examples.en: The UK form asked where the registered keeper's correspondence should be sent.
examples.zh: 英国表格问「车辆登记持有人」的信件应寄到哪里。

examples.en: I checked who was named as the registered keeper in the vehicle log book.
examples.zh: 我查看了车辆登记簿上谁被列为「车辆登记持有人」。

words.enDefinition: the person or entity recorded as owning a vehicle in the relevant registration system

examples.en: The form asked for the registered owner before requesting the vehicle's current address.
examples.zh: 表格先询问「登记车主」，然后要求填车辆目前所在的地址。

examples.en: I checked the document for the name of the registered owner before arranging collection.
examples.zh: 安排取车前，我查了文件上的「登记车主」姓名。

words.enDefinition: the part of a UK V5C given to the vehicle's new registered keeper

examples.en: The seller gave me the new keeper slip when I collected the car.
examples.zh: 我取车时，卖家把「新登记持有人联」交给了我。

examples.en: I kept the new keeper slip with the other documents from the sale.
examples.zh: 我把「新登记持有人联」与购车的其他文件一起保管。

words.enDefinition: the UK vehicle registration certificate known as the V5C, which records the vehicle and keeper

examples.en: I found the vehicle log book in the envelope from the UK licensing agency.
examples.zh: 我在英国车辆管理机构寄来的信封里找到了「英国车辆登记证」。

examples.en: The adviser explained which part of the vehicle log book showed the keeper.
examples.zh: 顾问指出了「英国车辆登记证」上写登记持有人的位置。

collocations: a copy of the vehicle log book

words.zhGloss: 车辆已出售或转让通知
words.enDefinition: in NSW, a notice that a vehicle has changed hands, given to the road authority
acceptedZhAnswers: 车辆已出售或转让通知

examples.en: The NSW portal recorded the notice of disposal in the seller's account.
examples.zh: 新南威尔士州门户网站在卖家账号里记录了「车辆已出售或转让通知」。

examples.en: I checked whether the notice of disposal showed the correct vehicle information.
examples.zh: 我核对了「车辆已出售或转让通知」上是否显示了正确的车辆信息。

collocations: a notice of disposal for a sold car

words.enDefinition: a written record that identifies the parties and describes the transfer of a vehicle for payment

examples.en: I kept the bill of sale with the other documents after collecting the used car.
examples.zh: 我取到二手车后，把「车辆买卖凭据」和其他文件放在一起。

examples.en: The clerk showed me which line on the bill of sale stated the price.
examples.zh: 办事员指给我看，「车辆买卖凭据」上的哪一行写了价格。

collocations: keep a copy of the bill of sale

words.enDefinition: a statement reporting a vehicle's recorded mileage at a transfer or sale

examples.en: The dealer completed the odometer disclosure while I checked the vehicle's identification details.
examples.zh: 我核对车辆识别信息时，经销商填完了「里程读数披露」。

examples.en: I compared the odometer disclosure with the mileage printed on the sale page.
examples.zh: 我把「里程读数披露」和买卖文件印的里程作了对照。

words.enDefinition: an administrative charge for recording a vehicle ownership or registration transfer

examples.en: The confirmation listed a vehicle transfer fee separately from the amount paid to the seller.
examples.zh: 确认单把「车辆过户费」和付给卖家的钱分开列了。

examples.en: I asked whether the vehicle transfer fee was included in the agency's receipt.
examples.zh: 我问机构的回执里是否包含「车辆过户费」。

words.enDefinition: an update to the official record of the person who keeps a vehicle

examples.en: The letter confirmed the change of registered keeper on the vehicle record.
examples.zh: 信确认车辆记录已「变更车辆登记持有人」。

examples.en: I asked how the UK office labelled a change of registered keeper online.
examples.zh: 我问英国办事处在网上怎样标记「变更车辆登记持有人」。

collocations: record a change of registered keeper
confirm a change of registered keeper
a notice of change of registered keeper

words.enDefinition: a check of official information about a vehicle's current registration

examples.en: I used a vehicle registration check to compare the details with the paper record.
examples.zh: 我通过「车辆登记查询」把信息与纸质记录作了比对。

examples.en: The service explained what information a vehicle registration check could show in that region.
examples.zh: 该服务说明了当地「车辆登记查询」能显示哪些信息。

collocations: the results of a vehicle registration check

words.enDefinition: a vehicle that is not registered in the relevant system at a given time

examples.en: The notice described the stored car as an unregistered vehicle under the local rules.
examples.zh: 通知按当地规定，把存放中的汽车称为「未登记的车辆」。

examples.en: I asked what the label unregistered vehicle meant on the sample record.
examples.zh: 我问样本记录中「未登记的车辆」这个标记是什么意思。

collocations: a notice about an unregistered vehicle

words.enDefinition: vehicle registration that has ended because it was not renewed in time

examples.en: The notice gave the date from which the record showed lapsed registration.
examples.zh: 通知写明，从哪天起记录就显示为「已经失效的车辆登记」。

examples.en: The clerk explained how the portal labelled lapsed registration in our example.
examples.zh: 办事员说明了门户网站怎样标记例子里的「已经失效的车辆登记」。

words.enDefinition: to formally return a vehicle's registration plates to the relevant authority

examples.en: I asked which office would accept the plates if I needed to surrender number plates.
examples.zh: 我问如果需要「交回车牌」，哪个办事处会收。

examples.en: The instructions explained where to surrender number plates after the vehicle was deregistered.
examples.zh: 说明写明车辆注销登记后，可以去哪里「交回车牌」。

collocations: be asked to surrender number plates
decide whether to surrender number plates

words.enDefinition: new registration plates issued to replace missing, damaged or unusable plates

examples.en: The agency sent a message confirming that the replacement number plates were ready.
examples.zh: 该机构发消息确认，「补换车牌」已经备好。

examples.en: I checked the collection address for the replacement number plates before leaving.
examples.zh: 出发前，我查了「补换车牌」的领取地址。

words.enDefinition: registration plates displaying a permitted number or letter combination chosen by the applicant

examples.en: The website showed examples of personalised plates without listing anyone's personal details.
examples.zh: 网站展示了「个性化车牌」的示例，没有列出任何人的个人资料。

examples.en: I asked where the agency recorded the new personalised plates after approving the request.
examples.zh: 我问申请获批后，该机构会把新的「个性化车牌」记录在哪里。

words.enDefinition: moving a registration plate number from one vehicle or registration to another under local rules

examples.en: The agency sent a confirmation after recording the plate transfer in its system.
examples.zh: 机构在系统里登记「车牌号码转移」后发来了确认。

examples.en: I asked which number the plate transfer notice referred to on the form.
examples.zh: 我问表上的「车牌号码转移」通知指的是哪个号码。

words.enDefinition: a document or record showing that an insurance policy covers a vehicle

examples.en: The rental office asked for proof of vehicle insurance before checking the reservation.
examples.zh: 租车办事处在核查预约之前，要求提供「车辆保险凭证」。

examples.en: I checked which page of the policy could be used as proof of vehicle insurance.
examples.zh: 我查看保单的哪一页可以作为「车辆保险凭证」。

collocations: provide written proof of vehicle insurance

words.enDefinition: a formal certificate recording details of insurance coverage for a motor vehicle

examples.en: The letter enclosed a motor insurance certificate for the vehicle named in the policy.
examples.zh: 信中附有保单所列车辆的「机动车保险证明」。

examples.en: I compared the motor insurance certificate with the copy saved by the office.
examples.zh: 我把「机动车保险证明」和办事处留存的副本作了对照。

words.zhGloss: 强制机动车第三方保险
words.enDefinition: legally required motor insurance against specified harm to other people or their property
acceptedZhAnswers: 强制机动车第三方保险

examples.en: The comparison chart listed compulsory third-party insurance separately from optional cover for the driver's car.
examples.zh: 对照表把「强制机动车第三方保险」与驾驶人可自选的本车保障分别列出。

examples.en: The guide explains what compulsory third-party insurance covers in each place on the list.
examples.zh: 指南分地区说明了「强制机动车第三方保险」的承保范围。

collocations: provide evidence of compulsory third-party insurance

words.zhGloss: 新南威尔士州强制第三方人身险
words.enDefinition: in New South Wales, the name for compulsory third-party motor injury insurance
acceptedZhAnswers: 新南威尔士州强制第三方人身险

examples.en: The New South Wales insurer sent the green slip details to the vehicle owner.
examples.zh: 新南威尔士州的保险公司向车主发送了「强制第三方人身险」的信息。

examples.en: Our New South Wales registration reminder included a reference to the green slip.
examples.zh: 我们收到的新南威尔士州车辆登记提醒中提到了「强制第三方人身险」。

words.enDefinition: a document showing that a vehicle met applicable roadworthiness standards in an inspection

examples.en: The registration office asked whether the roadworthiness certificate showed the same vehicle model.
examples.zh: 登记办事处问「车辆适行证明」上显示的是不是同一个车型。

examples.en: I checked the issue date printed near the top of the roadworthiness certificate.
examples.zh: 我在「车辆适行证明」顶部附近核对了签发日期。

words.enDefinition: a UK vehicle inspection assessing specified safety and environmental standards

examples.en: The UK adviser described the MOT test when we reviewed the registration documents.
examples.zh: 我们查看登记文件时，英国顾问介绍了「英国机动车定期检测」。

examples.en: I checked the date shown for the next MOT test in the vehicle record.
examples.zh: 我查了车辆记录中列出的下次「英国机动车定期检测」日期。

words.enDefinition: a UK certificate documenting that a vehicle passed an MOT inspection

examples.en: I checked the dates on the MOT certificate before sending the document copy.
examples.zh: 寄文件副本之前，我核对了「英国机动车检测证书」上的日期。

examples.en: The registration file showed where to find the latest MOT certificate online.
examples.zh: 登记档案标明了网上哪里可以查到最新的「英国机动车检测证书」。

collocations: a copy of the MOT certificate

words.enDefinition: a record of the findings of a vehicle examination by an inspector

examples.en: The vehicle inspection report listed the items that had been checked that morning.
examples.zh: 「车辆检查报告」列出了那天上午核查的项目。

examples.en: I compared the vehicle inspection report with the summary sent by the authority.
examples.zh: 我把「车辆检查报告」和主管机关发来的摘要作了对照。

collocations: a copy of the vehicle inspection report

words.enDefinition: the date by which a required inspection is due under the relevant schedule

examples.en: The vehicle record showed an inspection due date after the registration expiry date.
examples.zh: 车辆记录显示，「应接受检查的截止日」在登记到期日之后。

examples.en: I checked the inspection due date while reviewing the calendar on the portal.
examples.zh: 我查看门户网站日历时，核对了「应接受检查的截止日」。

collocations: a change to the inspection due date

words.enDefinition: a test measuring or checking pollutants released by a vehicle under applicable procedures

examples.en: The agency listed the emissions test separately from the general safety inspection.
examples.zh: 机构把「车辆尾气检测」和普通安全检查分开列出。

examples.en: The letter explained how the emissions test result appeared in the vehicle record.
examples.zh: 信上解释了「车辆尾气检测」结果在车辆记录中怎样显示。

words.enDefinition: a tax charged in connection with keeping or using a vehicle under a local tax system

examples.en: The UK guide placed vehicle tax under a different heading from registration.
examples.zh: 英国指南把「机动车税」和车辆登记放在不同的标题下。

examples.en: The reminder told me where the vehicle tax amount appeared in the account.
examples.zh: 提醒注明，账号里哪里显示「机动车税」金额。

words.enDefinition: a notice reminding a vehicle keeper about a vehicle tax action or due date

examples.en: I found a vehicle tax reminder in the correspondence from the licensing agency.
examples.zh: 我在许可机关来信中找到了一封「机动车税办理提醒」。

examples.en: The vehicle tax reminder had a reference field near the top of the page.
examples.zh: 「机动车税办理提醒」在页首附近有一个编号字段。

words.enDefinition: a formal UK notification that a vehicle is being kept off public roads

examples.en: The UK service listed Statutory Off Road Notification beside information about vehicle tax.
examples.zh: 英国政务服务把「英国车辆停驶申报」列在机动车税信息旁。

examples.en: I asked what Statutory Off Road Notification meant in the document shown in class.
examples.zh: 我问课堂所展示文件里的「英国车辆停驶申报」是什么意思。

collocations: make a Statutory Off Road Notification
record a Statutory Off Road Notification
a Statutory Off Road Notification confirmation

words.enDefinition: the official category used to determine how a vehicle is taxed

examples.en: The sample certificate recorded the tax class below the description of the vehicle.
examples.zh: 样本证书在车辆说明下方登记了「车辆税类别」。

examples.en: I asked the officer where the tax class appeared in the online record.
examples.zh: 我问办事员，「车辆税类别」显示在网上记录的哪个位置。

words.enDefinition: permission for a visitor's vehicle to park in a designated area

examples.en: I requested a visitor parking permit when a friend came to see the campus.
examples.zh: 朋友来看学校时，我申请了「访客停车许可证」。

examples.en: The map showed which streets accepted a visitor parking permit for that neighbourhood.
examples.zh: 地图标明那个街区哪些街道接受「访客停车许可证」。

collocations: apply for a visitor parking permit

words.enDefinition: a permit allowing parking for a stated short period under designated conditions

examples.en: The office issued a temporary parking permit for our moving day.
examples.zh: 办事处给我们搬家当天发了「临时停车许可证」。

examples.en: I checked the dates printed on the temporary parking permit before packing it.
examples.zh: 装进行李之前，我核对了「临时停车许可证」上印的日期。

collocations: a temporary parking permit for visitors

words.enDefinition: a parking permit recorded electronically instead of on a physical display card

examples.en: The council showed my digital parking permit in the account linked to my address.
examples.zh: 地方议会在与我地址关联的账号里显示了「电子停车许可证」。

examples.en: I asked how the digital parking permit would be identified at that car park.
examples.zh: 我问那个停车场会怎样识别「电子停车许可证」。

words.enDefinition: a permit authorizing access to designated parking spaces or accommodations under local rules

examples.en: The office explained where the accessible parking permit information appeared in the form.
examples.zh: 办事处说明了表格哪个位置有「无障碍停车许可」的信息。

examples.en: I checked the named holder on the accessible parking permit in the example.
examples.zh: 我核对了示例「无障碍停车许可」上列出的持有人。

collocations: apply for an accessible parking permit

words.enDefinition: the area where a particular parking permit can be used

examples.en: The map showed the parking permit zone as a shaded area around the residence.
examples.zh: 地图用阴影标出了公寓周围的「停车许可适用区域」。

examples.en: I checked whether the new address lay inside the same parking permit zone.
examples.zh: 我查了新地址是否还在同一个「停车许可适用区域」。

collocations: park within a parking permit zone
a change to the parking permit zone

words.enDefinition: the extension or reissue of a parking permit for another period

examples.en: The portal displayed my parking permit renewal after I signed in again.
examples.zh: 我重新登录后，门户网站显示了「停车许可续期」。

examples.en: I asked where the parking permit renewal date appeared on the account.
examples.zh: 我问账号里哪里显示「停车许可续期」日期。

words.enDefinition: a vehicle permitted to carry out an activity or use a specified place

examples.en: The form asked for the plate number of the permitted vehicle in the request.
examples.zh: 表格要求填写本次申请中「许可对应的车辆」的车牌号。

examples.en: I checked whether the permitted vehicle was the one shown in the booking.
examples.zh: 我核实「许可对应的车辆」是不是预约里显示的那辆。

words.enDefinition: the person or organization to whom a particular permit is issued

examples.en: The letter addressed the permit holder by the name on the application.
examples.zh: 信以申请表上的姓名称呼「许可证持有人」。

examples.en: I checked which details the permit holder needed to confirm on the page.
examples.zh: 我确认了「许可证持有人」需要在页面核实哪些信息。

words.enDefinition: the point when a permit stops being valid under its terms

examples.en: The portal displayed a reminder about permit expiry beside the account summary.
examples.zh: 门户网站在账号摘要旁显示了「许可到期」提醒。

examples.en: I asked where the permit expiry date would appear on the printed document.
examples.zh: 我问打印证件上的「许可到期」日期会显示在哪里。

words.enDefinition: the requirements or restrictions that apply when someone uses a permit

examples.en: The permit conditions were printed on the reverse of the notice we received.
examples.zh: 我们收到的通知在背面印了「许可附带条件」。

examples.en: I asked which permit conditions applied to the temporary event at the park.
examples.zh: 我问公园里的临时活动适用哪些「许可附带条件」。

words.enDefinition: an official period during which a particular parking space is withdrawn from ordinary use

examples.en: The sign showed a parking bay suspension next to our student residence.
examples.zh: 学生公寓旁的标识显示要「临时停用停车位」。

examples.en: I checked which dates the parking bay suspension covered for the repair project.
examples.zh: 我查了这次维修项目的「临时停用停车位」会涉及哪些日期。

words.enDefinition: a notice explaining when and where ordinary parking is temporarily suspended

examples.en: I read the parking suspension notice before arranging delivery to our building.
examples.zh: 安排向我们楼配送之前，我读了「停车位停用通知」。

examples.en: The parking suspension notice listed the first and last affected spaces on the street.
examples.zh: 「停车位停用通知」列了这条街受影响范围的首尾车位。

words.enDefinition: temporary permission to reserve street space for a moving truck

examples.en: Our moving truck permit listed the spaces we could use on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 我们的「搬家车辆临停许可」列出了周二可以使用的车位。

examples.en: I asked the housing office for help reading the moving truck permit.
examples.zh: 我请住宿办公室帮我看懂「搬家车辆临停许可」。

collocations: apply for a moving truck permit

words.enDefinition: a UK administrative order allowing temporary changes or restrictions on traffic under stated conditions

examples.en: The council leaflet mentioned a temporary traffic regulation order for the street event.
examples.zh: 地方议会宣传单提到，该街头活动有一份「临时交通管制令」。

examples.en: I checked which roads were named in the temporary traffic regulation order.
examples.zh: 我查看了「临时交通管制令」列明了哪些道路。

collocations: issue a temporary traffic regulation order
read a temporary traffic regulation order
a temporary traffic regulation order for road works

words.enDefinition: official permission for an organizer to close a road to traffic for a specified time

examples.en: The council issued a road closure permit for the weekend parade.
examples.zh: 市政部门为周末的游行发放了「道路封闭许可」。

examples.en: The organizers included the road closure permit number on their printed notices.
examples.zh: 组织者在印发的通知上写明了「道路封闭许可」的编号。

collocations: apply for a road closure permit

words.enDefinition: official permission to carry out specified work on a street during an approved period

examples.en: The contractor checked the street works permit before confirming the repair dates.
examples.zh: 承包商在确认维修日期前查看了「道路施工许可」。

examples.en: The approved street works permit covered the short section outside the library.
examples.zh: 获批的「道路施工许可」涵盖图书馆外的一小段道路。

collocations: apply for a street works permit

words.enDefinition: permission to occupy part of a public street for a specified activity

examples.en: The restaurant obtained a street use permit for tables on the sidewalk.
examples.zh: 餐厅取得了「街道使用许可」，可以在人行道上摆桌。

examples.en: The street use permit showed how much space the equipment could occupy.
examples.zh: 「街道使用许可」上标明了设备可以占用多少空间。

words.enDefinition: official permission to hold a particular event at a given place and time

examples.en: The organizer attached the event permit to the booking confirmation for volunteers.
examples.zh: 组织者将「活动许可」附在发给志愿者的预订确认函里。

examples.en: The event permit listed the time when the concert had to finish.
examples.zh: 「活动许可」写明了音乐会必须结束的时间。

words.enDefinition: a local licence that allows a trader to sell goods in approved public places

examples.en: The vendor displayed her street trading licence beside the menu every morning.
examples.zh: 摊主每天早上都把「街头经营许可证」摆在菜单旁。

examples.en: His street trading licence named the exact pitch where he could sell coffee.
examples.zh: 他的「街头经营许可证」标明了他可以售卖咖啡的具体摊位。

words.enDefinition: permission from a market authority or local government to operate a stall at a market

examples.en: The baker received a market stall permit for the Saturday craft market.
examples.zh: 这位烘焙师拿到了周六手工艺市集的「市集摊位许可证」。

examples.en: Did your market stall permit specify which entrance to use on Sunday?
examples.zh: 你的「市集摊位许可证」有没有写明周日从哪个入口进？

collocations: apply for a market stall permit

words.enDefinition: official permission to perform music or another act in a public space

examples.en: The violinist kept a copy of her busking permit in the instrument case.
examples.zh: 小提琴手在琴盒里放了一份「街头表演许可证」的复印件。

examples.en: The busking permit listed two locations where the band could perform that month.
examples.zh: 「街头表演许可证」列出乐队当月可以演出的两个地点。

words.enDefinition: local permission to collect charitable donations from people in a public place

examples.en: The charity included its street collection permit in the volunteer information pack.
examples.zh: 慈善机构把「街头募捐许可证」放进了志愿者资料包。

examples.en: Their street collection permit covered the town square during the winter fair.
examples.zh: 他们的「街头募捐许可证」适用于冬季市集举办期间的镇广场。

words.enDefinition: official permission to film at a specific location for an approved period

examples.en: The student producer kept the filming permit with the location booking documents.
examples.zh: 学生制片人把「拍摄许可证」和场地预订文件放在一起。

examples.en: One condition of the filming permit was that the doorway remained clear.
examples.zh: 「拍摄许可证」有一项条件是保持门口畅通。

words.enDefinition: a booking that sets aside a particular facility or space within a public park

examples.en: Our park reservation confirmed that the covered picnic area was available from noon.
examples.zh: 我们的「公园场地预约」确认了有顶的野餐区从中午起可以使用。

examples.en: I brought the park reservation confirmation to show the ranger at the entrance.
examples.zh: 我带了「公园场地预约」确认单，准备在入口给公园管理员看。

words.enDefinition: an official who processes licence applications or checks compliance with licensing rules

examples.en: A licensing officer contacted us to confirm the name on the application.
examples.zh: 一名「许可事务专员」联系我们核实申请上的姓名。

examples.en: The licensing officer explained which parts of the permit were still under review.
examples.zh: 「许可事务专员」说明了许可中哪些部分还在审核。

words.enDefinition: an official whose job is to check that particular rules are followed and act on violations

examples.en: An enforcement officer checked the temporary permit displayed on the delivery vehicle.
examples.zh: 一名「执法人员」查看了送货车上展示的临时许可证。

examples.en: The enforcement officer made a note of the stall's position on the street.
examples.zh: 「执法人员」记录了摊位在街上的位置。

words.enDefinition: a UK notice that formally requires payment of a civil penalty for a listed contravention

examples.en: The penalty charge notice listed the time the car entered the bus lane.
examples.zh: 「英国民事罚款通知单」写明了这辆车驶入公交专用道的时间。

examples.en: The council withdrew the penalty charge notice after reviewing the photographs she submitted.
examples.zh: 市政部门审查她提交的照片后，撤销了「英国民事罚款通知单」。

words.enDefinition: a formal UK notice about an unpaid parking penalty sent to the person believed responsible

examples.en: The notice to owner arrived at the address on the vehicle record.
examples.zh: 「未缴停车罚款通知书」寄到了车辆档案上的地址。

examples.en: The reference on the notice to owner matched the original penalty charge notice.
examples.zh: 「未缴停车罚款通知书」上的编号和最初的罚款通知单一致。

words.enDefinition: a charge for processing an application for official permission

examples.en: The council's website listed a separate permit application fee for larger events.
examples.zh: 市政部门的网站为较大型活动列出了单独的「许可证申请费」。

examples.en: She saved the receipt after paying the permit application fee through the portal.
examples.zh: 她通过门户网站支付「许可证申请费」后保存了收据。

words.enDefinition: an approved change to the details or conditions of an existing permit

examples.en: We requested a permit amendment when the market moved to another street.
examples.zh: 市集迁到另一条街后，我们申请办理「许可证变更」。

examples.en: The permit amendment changed the address and left the dates as originally approved.
examples.zh: 「许可证变更」修改了地址，日期仍沿用原审批结果。

words.enDefinition: the official reassignment of an existing permit to another holder

examples.en: The buyer asked whether a permit transfer was possible before taking over the stall.
examples.zh: 买方在接手摊位前询问是否可以办理「许可证转让」。

examples.en: The office completed the permit transfer once the new holder's name was confirmed.
examples.zh: 确认新持证人姓名后，办事处办完了「许可证转让」。

words.enDefinition: the formal cancellation of an existing permit by the authority that issued it

examples.en: The board recorded the permit revocation in the minutes of its monthly meeting.
examples.zh: 委员会把「撤销许可证」的决定记入了月度会议纪要。

examples.en: The letter gave the effective date of the permit revocation and a case number.
examples.zh: 信中写明了「撤销许可证」的生效日期和案件编号。

words.enDefinition: a document or other evidence showing that a general requirement does not apply

examples.en: The officer asked for proof of exemption when checking the vehicle's emissions paperwork.
examples.zh: 工作人员在核对车辆排放材料时要求出示「豁免证明」。

examples.en: She uploaded her proof of exemption in the section marked supporting documents.
examples.zh: 她在标有补充材料的栏目里上传了「豁免证明」。

words.enDefinition: a formal request for an authority to review or overturn a parking penalty

examples.en: He included the parking receipt as evidence in his parking appeal last week.
examples.zh: 他上周提交「停车处罚申诉」时附上了停车收据作为证据。

examples.en: The council acknowledged his parking appeal in an email with a reference number.
examples.zh: 市政部门发邮件确认收到了他的「停车处罚申诉」，并附上编号。

words.enDefinition: the act of putting a permit where it can be seen during a check

examples.en: The parking office illustrated proper permit display with a picture of the windscreen.
examples.zh: 停车管理部门用一张挡风玻璃的图片说明了正确的「许可证展示」方式。

examples.en: The market handbook explained the permit display rules for shared stalls in summer.
examples.zh: 市集手册说明了夏季共用摊位的「许可证展示」规定。

words.enDefinition: a person or group responsible for planning and managing a public event

examples.en: The event organizer gave the council an updated contact number on Monday.
examples.zh: 「活动组织者」周一向市政部门提供了更新后的联系电话。

examples.en: The notice referred questions about the proposed parade route to the event organizer.
examples.zh: 通告说，有关拟定游行路线的问题可以向「活动组织者」咨询。

words.enDefinition: the time during which an official notice must remain available to the public

examples.en: The public notice period for the proposed street closure ended on Friday.
examples.zh: 这项拟议道路封闭安排的「公示期」于周五结束。

examples.en: Residents could read the application online throughout the public notice period that spring.
examples.zh: 那年春天，居民在整个「公示期」都可以在线查看申请。

words.enDefinition: the time allowed for affected people or the public to comment on a proposal

examples.en: The council extended the consultation period after residents asked for more time.
examples.zh: 居民希望有更多时间，市政部门于是延长了「意见征询期」。

examples.en: The dates of the consultation period were printed beneath the proposed parking changes.
examples.zh: 拟议停车调整方案的下方印着「意见征询期」的起止日期。

words.enDefinition: an appointment reserved for officials or an approved inspector to inspect a vehicle

examples.en: The garage emailed the vehicle inspection booking details to the new owner.
examples.zh: 修理厂把「车辆检验预约」的详情发邮件给了新车主。

examples.en: I changed the vehicle inspection booking because the car was still being repaired.
examples.zh: 车还在维修，我就改了「车辆检验预约」的时间。

words.enDefinition: a code that identifies a particular inspection, booking, or related record

examples.en: The clerk used the inspection reference to find the report on the system.
examples.zh: 办事员用「检验查询编号」在系统里找到了报告。

examples.en: The inspection reference was printed beside the vehicle number on the appointment confirmation.
examples.zh: 「检验查询编号」印在预约确认单的车辆编号旁边。

words.enDefinition: a drawing showing the layout of a site and where a proposed activity will take place

examples.en: The site plan showed the position of the stalls and the public entrance.
examples.zh: 「场地平面图」标出了各摊位和公众入口的位置。

examples.en: The organizer submitted a revised site plan when the performance area moved indoors.
examples.zh: 表演区移到室内后，组织者提交了修改后的「场地平面图」。

words.enDefinition: insurance covering certain legal liabilities for injury or property damage suffered by members of the public

examples.en: The venue asked for a certificate of public liability insurance before the festival.
examples.zh: 场地方在节日前要求提供「公众责任保险」证明。

examples.en: The club's public liability insurance policy listed the insured activities in an appendix.
examples.zh: 俱乐部的「公众责任保险」保单在附录中列出了受保活动。

words.enDefinition: a permit condition setting the hours during which an activity or business may operate

examples.en: The operating hours condition allowed the stall to open from nine on Saturdays.
examples.zh: 「营业时段限制条款」允许摊位每周六从九点开始营业。

examples.en: The owner requested a change to the operating hours condition for summer evenings.
examples.zh: 经营者申请调整夏季晚间的「营业时段限制条款」。

collocations: comply with an operating hours condition

words.enDefinition: an official list recording permits issued by an authority and their relevant details

examples.en: The council added the new event approval to its online permit register.
examples.zh: 市政部门把这项新获批的活动录入了网上「许可证登记册」。

examples.en: The permit register showed a different expiry date from the copy we received.
examples.zh: 「许可证登记册」显示的到期日与我们拿到的副本不一致。

words.enDefinition: an official website for checking the details or validity of a licence

examples.en: We entered the number in the licence verification portal to check the spelling.
examples.zh: 我们把编号输入「许可证核验平台」，用来核对拼写。

examples.en: The licence verification portal displayed the original issue date beneath the holder's name.
examples.zh: 「许可证核验平台」在持证人姓名下方显示了首次签发日期。
